license_basis: Pinned official root LICENSE.md and README MIT license update; standard human models and diffuse textures only. No animations, animals, facial duplicate exports or authoring sources are included.
attribution: Microsoft Rocketbox Avatar Library; original avatar creation Rocketbox / Markus Wojcik; contributors listed in UPSTREAM_README.md.
preparation: All standard FBX is original Rocketbox, independently verified against the pinned Git blob SHA. Textures marked source_sha256 are converted from locally verified official TGA. Textures marked derivative are openOMSI MIT JPEG/PNG conversions (JPEG is already lossy), verified by ZIP entry CRC and image SHA-256, then resized locally. Their source_sha256 is null: original TGA was not fetched or locally verified for that entry. Runtime PNG uses <=1024 px for heads/shared face atlases and <=512 px for other maps, Pillow LANCZOS; alpha retained. No derivative FBX, normal/specular maps or motions are bundled.

inventory.runtime_estimate_basis: FBX unchanged; body/opacity 512 px, head/shared face atlas 1024 px. Estimate; actual bytes recorded after conversion.
inventory.age_note: Official folders identify children but do not label older adults separately. All adult/profession models are included; no unsupported elderly census.
